reallot: They were realloted additional farm land
enfeoff: put in possession of land in exchange for a pledge of service, in feudal society
He enfeoffed his son-in-law with a large estate in Scotland
electrocute: kill by electrocution, as in the electric chair
She dropped the hair dryer into the bathtub and was instantly electrocuted
rehear: hear or try a court case anew
resemble: appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
She resembles her mother very much§This paper resembles my own work
protuberate: cause to bulge out or project
